messages:
sana: quick sync 1: i'm about to open a small PR to clean up the error-ref 429 + timeout section. current doc mixes context-trimming notes with retry examples and the SDK links are out-of-date. plan: replace with a concise python example, an explicit Retry-After parser note, and a one-line cross-ref to runtime FAQ about trimming order. will push in ~20m.
luis: sounds good. for python snippet can you show the hosted SDK call exactly (copy-paste ready) and the recommended retry config: max_retries, base_backoff_ms, cap_ms, jitter=True? many users copy naive loops.
rachael: please add a short sentence clarifying order: "we trim input to fit model limits before choosing a fallback" so customers understand why quality-based fallbacks might not see the full prompt. also update the anchor in the SDK guide link 1: CI flagged it earlier.
doc-bot: linkcheck: broken link "/docs/sdk/retries-old" referenced in error-reference/429.md -> 404 (detected 45m ago)
sana: fixed the reference to `/docs/sdk/retries-guide#policy-quickstart` and added a tiny changelog entry. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1603
luis: for the python example, maybe include both header-first and fallback exponential backoff. e.g. `wait = parse_retry_after(resp.headers.get('Retry-After')) or min(5000, 200 * 2**attempt)` so it's explicit.
rachael: also add a one-line ops note under "fallback behavior": "Prefer a model variant fallback when output quality is critical; prefer quantized or lower-latency variants when cost/latency is the priority." keeps expectations clear.
tony: after merge can someone drop a 2-line note in #support & #runtime so we cut down on duplicate tickets?
sana: will post after merge. assigning to @rachael for final review. thanks all!
